# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class FutureExampleAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Subscribe to the continuous SPX future, which provides daily data.
        self._future = self.add_future(Future.of("SPX", Resolution.DAILY))
        # Use a rolling method to automatically roll the contract to the next month's contract.
        self._future.rolling_method = FutureContractRollingMethods.CREATE_NEW_CONTRACT
        # Warm up the portfolio value to account for the buying power of 1 contract.
        self.set_portfolio_initial_value(self._future.contract.multiplier)

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        if self.portfolio.invested:
            return
        # Select the mapped future contract.
        contract = self._future.mapped_contract
        # Check if the current contract is expiring to avoid liquidation fee.
        expiry = contract.expiry
        if expiry < self.time + timedelta(30):
            self.liquidate(self._future)
            return
        # Request the data of the next contract to trade.
        next_contract = self.next_future_contract(self._future)
        if next_contract:
            self.set_holdings(self._future, 1)
